author: cli
text: Re-read 2026-08-17. 'Load the map once; shared by every query' still describes it exactly - one Indexer, one load_existing, one load_raw_edges, one EdgeBuilder.load, one MetaStore, returned as a tuple every query destructures. The raw-edge load matters more now than when the comment was written: 0.55.5's unresolved-reference counter reads ix._raw_edges, and it only has them because _ctx loads them here.
